avis.titre: Classy skincare is what I call it
avis.texte: I've been using Lancer Polish and my skin feels incredibly smooth and refreshed. I love how It gently exfoliates without being harsh, leaving my face brighter and softer after each use. A little goes a long way, (Literally) ☺️ it gives my skin a healthy glow that lasts all day.

Okay this polish honestly surprised me. I use a lot of exoliators because most of them don't work but this actually did after a few uses. The texture is really nice—slightly gritty but still gentle—and you can actually feel it working as you use it. It exfoliates the skin really well without being harsh. It also rinses off easily and doesn't leave any weird residue, which I love. Definitely something I'd keep in my routine when I want a quick refresh and smoother skin at home. I recieved this product as a promotional review
Love how my skin feels after using it! So comfortable, soft and fresh!! Love it and recommend it to everyone

avis.titre: Beautiful results, but use with caution for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I received this product as part of a promotional campaign. After trying Lancer The Method: Polish, I have to say my skin looks and feels noticeably smoother and more radiant. The results are genuinely impressive. However, I would not recommend using it frequently if you have thin or sensitive skin like mine. My skin needs time to recover between uses — this polish is quite active, and overdoing it can lead to irritation. Less is definitely more here.

This physical and enzyme exfoliator from Lancer is the ultimate skincare step for smooth, soft skin. I typically veer away from physical exfoliators for my face as I feel that they do more harm than good, but this one doesn't hurt my skin at all and leaves my skin feeling ridiculously smooth. The enzyme exfoliators in this really do a great job - while the natural mineral crystals help to slough away dead skin, the enzyme exfoliators are what truly refine the skin. My face looks brighter and clearer with zero irritation. This is perfect for anyone who has days where their skin feels dull.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I've been really impressed with this product. It has a strong exfoliating feel, but it didn't irritate my skin at all, which is something I'm always cautious about. I used it about 2–3 times a week, and over time I definitely noticed a difference in my skin's texture. My face felt smoother and looked more refined without feeling overly stripped or sensitive. I also like that it gives you that "deep clean" feeling without being too harsh. Some exfoliators can feel aggressive or leave my skin irritated, but this one feels balanced and effective. It's become a consistent part of my routine because it actually delivers results while still being gentle enough for regular use. I received as a part of an educational promotion."

I enjoyed using this facial exfoliator, and I felt like it elevated my skincare routine. I would recommend it. What I loved: - The product is easy to apply and has the perfect texture for exfoliation. The granules are substantial enough to scrub away dead skin cells and sebum, but not at all abrasive or irritating to the skin. - The product is gentle enough to use daily and definitely refines and brightens my face and neck after use. - After each use, my skin felt smooth and fresh, and my complexion looked bright and even. What could be better: - The product is a bit pricey, and the bland packaging does not really seem to reflect the price point. *** I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: EXACTLY WHAT I WAS MISSING IN MY ROUTINE!
avis.texte: As a long time beauty and skincare enthusiast, I'm absolutely obsessed with this exfoliating product from Lancer Skincare! I instantly noticed a significant difference in the texture and glow in my skin. It leaves my face completely smooth and so soft. It gently removes all of the dead skin which is great for those with dry patches or dry skin. I love that it's gentle enough to be used daily because most exfoliators you can't use every day. I absolutely recommend this product and it has drastically helped my skincare regime. This product also helps my skin look smoother when I apply makeup which is a huge plus. Overall, I'm obsessed and I will be repurchasing when I run out!

I LOVE this polish. I've never really tried at home solutions like this even though I have wanted to because I was worried about drying out my skin and ruining the barrier. This is gentle enough to use every day if you wanted to. I have only had to use it 3 times a week to maintain a silky smooth skin. I could probably get away with less, but I love the results. The scent is almost herbal floral, and it's nowhere near as strong as a lot of the other similar products you may have smelt in the past. I'm noticing my pores aren't as visible some of my dark spots seem lighter and my fine lines are sticking out less. And of course silky skin! Love this polish and you will as well!

avis.titre: A little too harsh for me to use daily
avis.texte: I really liked this exfoliating polish. The granules were super fine and did a great job removing dead skin. Although the description states it is gentle on the skin, I felt it was a bit harsh on my skin and left my skin pretty red afterwards. I did love how my skin feels afterwards so I tried to only use it at nighttime so my skin could settle overnight. I do have somewhat sensitive skin so anyone reading should take that into consideration.

POLISH has completely elevated my skincare routine! From the very first use, I noticed how incredibly smooth and refined my skin felt without any harshness. The exfoliating granules are effective yet gentle, giving me that polished, fresh-from-a-facial glow right at home. What I love most is how it manages to deeply exfoliate while still being suitable for sensitive skin. I'm usually cautious with physical exfoliants, but this one never leaves my skin feeling irritated or overworked. Instead, it feels balanced, soft, and perfectly prepped for the rest of my skincare. The light herbal scent is another standout feature. It's clean, subtle, and spa-like without being overpowering. It makes the whole experience feel calming and luxurious, turning a simple step into something I actually look forward to. *I received as a part of an educational promotion

This physical and enzyme exfoliator from Lancer is the ultimate skincare step for smooth, soft skin. I typically veer away from physical exfoliators for my face as I feel that they do more harm than good, but this one doesn't hurt my skin at all and leaves my skin feeling ridiculously smooth. The enzyme exfoliators in this really do a great job - while the natural mineral crystals help to slough away dead skin, the enzyme exfoliators are what truly refine the skin. My face looks brighter and clearer with zero irritation. This is perfect for anyone who has days where their skin feels dull.

avis.titre: For skin as smooth as butter
avis.texte: As someone with super textured skin, I have tried dozens of scrubs and nothing comes close to the results I get with Lancer. After just one use, my skin felt so soft and smooth. My foundation goes on like butter now without any flakey crusty areas. I've always struggled with extra flakey skin between my eyebrows despite trying so many products and different methods and after just a few uses of the Lancer scrub it's now completely gone. After a couple weeks of using this consistently I've also seen a noticeable brightening of my skin and my skincare products perform so much better because they can penetrate deeper thanks to removing all the dead skin and debris. If you struggle with texture this is a product you will want to add to your rotation. I received this product for free in exchange for educational purposes.

Im very impressed with this Polish . I've been using it for a few weeks and it's helped with the texture of my skin.My skin has been very dull because of the dry weather during the winter and this polish made it feel very smooth and brighter . The texture feels like little crystals that penetrate deep into the skin, taking all the dead skin cells away . Giving you a glow right after . I highly recommend this product for both normal and combination skin.

Lancer facial polish is my newest obsession. It is SO good. My skin felt softer after the first use. I love the fine gritty texture, it is like getting microdermabrasion at home. Be very gentle, you do not need to apply any pressure when massaging this polish on your skin. It contains brightening ingredients, such as pumpkin enzyme, which give your skin the glow it deserves. The fine grit speeds up cell turnover rate and removes dead skin cells, revealing smoother, softer skin. I do find my faint forehead lines have diminished since adding this polish to my morning routine. A little goes a long way, this tube will last you a good while. I received this product as part of an educational promotion.

The Lancer Face Polish effectively cleans and exfoliates my face. It seems to have helped with improving my skin texture over several weeks of use. The texture is grainy but with particles that feel very small and fine, as opposed to scrubs from other brands where the grains can be larger and rougher on skin. When I use this product it doesn't irritate my skin or eyes so seems suitable for those with sensitive skin or eyes. The price point is high but there is a very generous amount of product in the tube and a little goes a long way so the value seems very good. This face polish is a good addition to a skincare regimen for promoting smooth skin texture and removing older dead skin. I look forward to continuing to use this and seeing benefits in my skin.

This exfoliate is amazing. It leaves my slins super soft and smooth bright And feeling rejuvenated. I love the way it makes my skin feel. I added this into my skin regiment and my skin is looking much better lately. I give this product 5 stars because it actually gives great results.

This skin care polish is amazing. First off it comes in a huge bottle that will last a long time. Most skin polishers come in a way smaller tube. This polish instantly removed my dead skin and sloughed off extra debris and grime that builds up after using primer and SPF on a daily basis. This product is gentle and doesn't have any harmful ingredients that scratch up your skin like walnut or apricot seeds. This product uses high-end ingredients that gently slough off dead skin and debris. This product is gentle enough to use every day yet effective to see a difference. I use this for seven days straight and I could instantly see the difference in my skin. My primer and makeup went on more easily and I didn't feel so congested. I received this product gratis in exchange for my honest review. I have combination skin and this did not irritate me.

If you're looking for gentle but effective exfoliation, look no further! The method Polish by lancer has made dull skin glow, which I so desperately needed! My face and décolleté look youthful and feel refreshed! I suffer from melasma and my skin has taken a hit post partum and after using this product, I look like I just has microdermabrasion or a chemical peel!

Been wanting to try a lancer product because they have a good reputation and I have more trust in them for the fact that they are dermatologists. The packaging is nice and sleek. The formula itself is nice and fine. The issue I have with a lot of exfoliating scrubs is that the granules are too large so they really don't feel like they are doing much. This has a much more sandpaper consistency, not to say that it feels like super fine sandpaper but using that is example as to why I think it's more effective. It leaves your skin feeling smooth and new. The scent is more of a medical grade smell that sort of reminds me of proactive if anyone remembers that brand. Overall, awesome scrub that I will use once or twice a week! Product was received as a part of an educational promotion

I cannot begin to tell you my level of excitement when I found out this would be getting carried here. I previously kept seeing advertisements for it and eventually decided to give it a try. For reference I'm 40 yrs old with some signs of aging, periodic hormonal acne (love that for me), and occasionally sensitive skin. Now this face polish is no joke my holy grail. I was honestly shocked the first time I used it. It has a slight grainy but creamy texture, a faint anise scent - which I love- that doesn't linger and is not medicinal, and is easy to spread on my face and work into the skin. My face was the smoothest it has ever felt after using! Like drastically, noticeably exfoliated without any irritation or redness. Some products will irritate my skin, especially face polishes but my skin loves this product. When I tell you that I have never found a more effective chemical or physical exfoliator, it is not exaggeration. I will never be without this face polish. I use a small amount a few times a week and the bottle lasts about 4-5 months. Full disclosure, I did receive this one for educational and testing purposes, so the product can have real reviews from actual people who have used it, but this is my third bottle.

I use The Method Polish by Lancer 2-3 days per week and it has changed my skin for the better. The chemical and physical exfoliant help to remove the dead skin cells, which have allowed my skincare products to penetrate deeper and worker better.

The Lancer Skincare The Method Polish for normal-combination skin is great! I actually love it! The scent is lavender and smells super good! The consistency is a super fine gritty scrub with a medium viscosity. It contains pumpkin and pomegranate enzyme, which helps to exfoliate dead skin cells from the surface. It also contains magnesium and sodium, which are natural minerals that are not too abrasive for delicate skin areas. Upon use, I could feel my skin felt exfoliated and smooth texture-wise, and I could visually see dead skin was removed. When you exfoliate the dead skin, it will not sit inside wrinkles, making them more pronounced. To use, apply it to damp skin and then gently massage into skin on your face, neck, and décolleté. *Received as a part of an educational promotion*

The size is outstanding and the package is phenomenal. It applies well and my skin feels extra clean and ready for my skincare routine. The only problem was that this product irritated my skin unfortunately, even on the first try. May give it another try. I received this as a part of an educational promotion

I have tried countless products over the years but LANCER Skincare The Method Polish for Normal Skin has genuinely changed how I think about exfoliation and skincare overall. From the very first use I could tell this product was something different because it delivers immediate results while still feeling like a luxurious experience rather than a harsh treatment. The texture strikes the perfect balance between being effective and gentle as it contains fine minerals that buff away dead skin cells without causing irritation or microtears which is something I have struggled with when using other scrubs. What impressed me most is how smooth and refreshed my skin felt right after rinsing it off and that glow was not temporary because over time my complexion has become noticeably more even radiant and healthy looking. The formula feels well thought out and high quality as it cleans deeply while also prepping the skin to better absorb serums and moisturizers which makes the rest of my routine more effective. I have normal skin that can sometimes lean slightly dry or slightly oily depending on the season and this product adapts beautifully without ever making my skin feel stripped or overly tight. Instead it leaves behind a clean polished feeling that still retains moisture and comfort. Another thing I really appreciate is how little product you actually need for each use which makes the jar last longer than expected and adds to its value. The scent is subtle clean and spa like which

I have had a chance to this this polish which definitely holds up its name. The polish had quite a grit to it. I was surpised the firat time i used it as i needed to adjust how i applied it. O have mized feelings over this one. Does it work? Absolutely. Mu skin is currently dry and flaky with acne prone to boot. This exfoliates better than anything else ive used. My skin feels baby soft after rinsing the product off. Follow with a cleaner then moisturizer and ur glowing. My issue is i cant use this more than a couple times a week or im over exfoliating. The grittiness is pretty intense and if u scrub too hard it can become a bit ouchy. I keep this in my rotation for the every couple days treatment whichis what works for me. If u have sensitive skin or broken skin i would proceed with caution.

avis.titre: Nice scrub that makes your skin feel so soft after
avis.texte: Been wanting to try a lancer product because they have a good reputation and I have more trust in them for the fact that they are dermatologists. The packaging is nice and sleek. The formula itself is nice and fine. The issue I have with a lot of exfoliating scrubs is that the granules are too large so they really don't feel like they are doing much. Overall, awesome scrub that I will use once or twice a week!

avis.titre: Wow! Best facial exfoliator that I've ever used.
avis.texte: I'm really impressed with The Method: Polish by Lancer. It's a thick consistency. It has a light eucalyptus or minty scent. It has teeny tiny granules that gently remove dead skin leaving my skin looking "polished"/dewy. It's also very hydrating, so my skin is so soft afterwards. I'm always saying that I need to exfoliate my face. I've tried so many tools and products in my 44 years, and none do what The Method: Polish, does nor as well. This is hands-down the best facial exfoliator that I've ever used. Immediate results after one use. You can see and feel the difference. This is now an essential part of my skincare. I've been raving to my friends about it. *this product was received in exchange for my honest review.

I received this in exchange for my honest review. This is a gentle but effective exfoliating polish. It works so well and it didn't break me out. It makes my skin so soft and smooth. It has a spa like fragrance. It is definitely worth every penny because I have very sensitive dry acne prone skin and it is amazing for my skin.

Lifeless and sans luster, my aging skin is not bouncing back they way it once did. Testing this Lancer The Method: Polish has been hope-filled! Light abrasion to slough off sallow cells gently, this adds not only a morning pep but plump to my skin. Leaning quite sensitive, I opted to employ every other morning and my skin adapted beautifully. Beyond enthused to continue use with the ample product remaining!

I'm in my 40s now, so my skin and I… we've had a journey 😄 But ever since I started using Lancer Skincare The Method: Polish, things feel a lot more under control. First of all, it exfoliates without feeling like I'm sanding down my face (thank God). It's gentle but still gets the job done—my skin feels baby-smooth right after. And the glow? Let's just say I catch myself checking the mirror like, "okayyy, who is she?" 👀 What I love most is it doesn't dry me out. At this age, anything that keeps my skin soft and happy is staying in my routine. I use it a few times a week, and it just makes my skin look fresh, clean, and a little more "alive." Honestly, if my skin could talk, it would say: "finally… you're doing something right." 😂

This exfoliator is honestly a game changer. It leaves my skin incredibly smooth, soft, and glowing right after the first use. The texture is rich with fine exfoliating particles that effectively remove dead skin without feeling too harsh or irritating. I love how polished and refreshed my face looks — it gives that "spa-like" result at home. I live in Florida, and it really helps keep my skin hydrated despite the heat and humidity. It also helps my skincare absorb better afterward, and over time my skin tone looks more even and radiant. A little goes a long way, so the tube lasts quite a while. If you want instantly smoother, brighter, and well-hydrated skin, this one is absolutely worth it.

Very surprised is the last thing i thought i would say while trying the LANCER SKIN CARE The Method: Polish. As a dry, sensitive and acne prone girl i am always hesitant to try overly harsh products. Finding the right chemical exfoliant is difficult enough, let alone a physical exfoliant. My overly congested skin needs exfoliation but the aftermath of the exfoliants are what deters me from using them. But i was taken by surprise by how well this physical exfoliant worked. Now don't be alarmed, it is an exfoliant so the very fine beads do rub against the skin. But i think it's gentle enough that it doesn't leave my skin excessively dry or irritated after using it. I initially began using it every other day to see how it works. And i was happy with the results, my skin was soft and supple after using it and i didn't experience any sensitivity after i applied my skincare. I would always use it on damp skin and would slightly emulsify the polish between my fingers before rubbing it on my face. I did try using it daily for a few days and the results were pretty similar. My skin didn't react to the natural minerals or pomegranate enzymes and afterwards it always looked cleaner. I plan to incorporate the polisher in my skin care routine and hope to see more results. This was collected as part of an educational promotion.

The Lancer Skincare polish is good to remove all the dead skin cells and it leaves my face looking fresh and glossy. I could instantly feel the warmth of the scrub once I applied it to my face and it worked quickly in exfoliating and it made my face feel soft. I wish the smell was a little more subtle and light to make the experience more relaxing instead of a pumpkin earthy smell. I used the scrub at least 3 times a week and did see results of my face looking more plump. This Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

As a 36 year old mom, i know im always thrilled to discover and try a new face exfoliator. Im all about getting rid of dead skin on my face and body, and this Lancer "The method polish" has quickly become a staple in my every day routine. First of all i love the texture and formula. It has a super good grit to it, so your going to get a very good exfoliation when using it. I also love the warming sensation when applying to my face and neck as it makes it unique and different from alot of face exfoliators out here. This is definitely a luxury skincare item thats worth the money in my opinion. Ive been this every day and im down to about half a bottle lol. I definitely plan on repurchasing when i run out and can get a discount haha because the price is very steep, but man i love it that much that i almost dont care. My skin is super smoothe every single time i use this and my skincare applies like butter afterwards. Overall i REALLY love this facial exfoliator and plan on getting another bottle when i run out, even if it takes half my bank account lol.

avis.titre: Makes my Skin So Soft and Smooth!
avis.texte: Disclaimer: I received this product for free for testing and review purposes. I am very picky when it comes to facial exfoliants. Lancer The Method: Polish (Normal) is very comfortable to use, yet it fully and effectively exfoliates my face. It is the absolute perfect facial exfoliant for me. It feels so rejuvenating and gives my skin a thorough exfoliation. My skin looks and feels smoother after use. It also makes my skin look bright and radiant. My skin has never felt softer. This product has been such a game-changer for my dry skin. My makeup goes on so much better and it looks so nice on my skin. There are no more dry patches. Lancer The Method: Polish (Normal) is such a great facial exfoliant! I definitely recommend it!

I really like a physical exfoliant in my routine a few times a week to slough off the dead skin and refine texture. The formula of Lancer The Method: Polish is truly unparalleled. The grit is ultra fine and gentle but truly smooths out my skin like nothing else. Along with having actual scrub particles in the product, this boasts enzymes that also exfoliate the skin so it's a two-in-one powerhouse. I use this about three times a week and my skin feels super soft and never dried out or sensitive afterwards. I cannot recommend highly enough! Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

Founded by a dermatologist, Lancer's The Method system has 3 steps: Polish, Cleanse, and Nourish. I'm here to review The Method Polish, which is the first step, and gentle enough to use every day. Natural minerals are mixed with pomegranate and pumpkin enzymes to gently exfoliate, smooth texture, and boost radiance. I use a pea-size portion on my face and neck in the shower. It leaves my skin so smooth, not tight or stripped, and ready for next steps. After a week's usage, I can tell my skin looks brighter and smoother. I'm eager to try their complete system to achieve my best skin! Product received as a part of an education program.

Totally the best ever face polish I have ever used, Lancer the method polish to normal-combination skin is amazing on my mature skin that requires daily steps to feel and look presentable. I have tried in the past similar products, but have never achieved such an ultimate visible result. Skin is glass smooth and so soft, just like from the spa, radiant and shines, by touching it's feels unreal healthy and those tiny beads lift all outer dead skin. They help to move extra fluid and toxins from the tissues. I use tiny tear of the polish and it spreads all over, doing gentle lymphatic massage to heat and stimulate the vessels. Wave like moves to help reduce bags under eyes, it's such a pleasure to achieve beautiful skin. I would say the scent is unique as a product itself, contains pomegranate and pumpkin enzymes formulated with natural minerals. I feel renewed every time I use Lancer, bright and luminous. For my opinion it's best so far that I have experienced, would suggest to any age and it would do outstanding result on your skin. I received as part of an educational promotion.

At first, this felt a little too much for me, probably because I wasn't used to using this kind of exfoliating product. The texture felt stronger than what I normally go for, so I had to ease into it. But the more I used it, the more I started liking it and appreciating how well it works on my skin. It really helps remove buildup and leaves my face feeling so fresh, smooth, and clean after every use. What I love most is how soft my skin feels after washing it off. It gives me that deep clean feeling without making my skin feel stripped. Over time, it has become one of those products I actually look forward to using because I love how refreshed my skin feels afterward. This is honestly one of my favorite skincare products now, and I can really see why so many people love it.

This exfoliator has been my go to for years. It wipes away dull skin and allows serums and other products to penetrate more deeply. This gives quick true results and is worth every penny and more. I highly recommend for 25yr olds and up!

avis.titre: Scrub slushy, softness like never before and brightening
avis.texte: Lancer The Method Polish is a product I had heard about before and really wanted to try. I didn't understand the concept of micro injury before but after some research I now do and it's clear to me that my skin needed it! I have fine lines and wrinkles and a lot of hyper pigmentation and some sun damage. I not only got overall brightening, but I also noticed a big difference in those darker spots from the sun. They really lightened up. Aside from that the texture is like a scrub slushy and is so satisfying to wash off your face. When you put it on, there's a slight warmth to it and a light pumpkin smell. When you wash it off, it feels the same way as when I dermaplane my face. That baby, soft skin. You know with this product that you are stimulating cell turnover. I was lucky enough to receive this product as part of an educational promotion program. I will now be adding it to my daily regimen and can't live without it!

As a 45-year-old woman with maturing skin, this has been a lifesaver. I used prescription treatments a few times a week so sometimes battle with some residual flaky skin and dryness. Being able to incorporate the polish into my routine a few times a week has helped my skin day looking fresh and hydrated and ready to put on my skin care. It helps my skin look glowy and fresh. The texture of the polish reminds me of a thicker sand, gives a grear polish without stripping your skin or irritating it. Overall, great face polish! received as a part of an educational promotion.

I have found my favorite facial polish/scrub: The Method: Polish. It's no joke; this stuff is absolutely amazing! I loved it after the first use. The texture of the granules is super fine yet effective, and I can see how smooth and revitalized my skin looks after just one application. I also love the scent, which reminds me of Dead Sea salts—it's a fresh, organic, seaside smell that enhances the overall experience. I am now hooked on this brand and want to try more products. I genuinely believe this scrub is worth every single penny, and it's a product I don't want to run out of; I have to restrain myself from using it every day. I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture; my redness and blackheads are diminishing, and I feel my skin looks more vibrant and glowing. It's a major win for me, and I will continue to use this brand. This is definitely my favorite facial product of the year! This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

Really nice, high quality scrub for the face. The grains are large and really give you a good scrub to remove dead skin cells. I would definitely recommend using this product about once, maybe twice a week. My face is super smooth, even and feels clean and fresh. It has a nice, fresh scent to it kind of refreshing. The tube is huge, you will get your money's worth if you purchase this one. I squeeze out about a dime size of product and rub it into my skin, it's plenty full and will give you a great scrub. Highly recommend for someone looking for a bit more of a coarser grain of scrub, to have a deep exfoliating.

This was my first time trying Lancer Skincare and I am very impressed with The Method: Polish! This daily exfoliating polish is definitely worth the price point. It's gentle on my skin while still giving me great results. The exfoliant is very fine, which allows me to gently massage into my skin without any rough irritation. I use this after cleansing and removing my makeup and it leaves my skin feeling so clean and refreshed. My skin feels so soft and smooth and my skin tone just looks more even and bright overall. I would definitely recommend! Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

I used the Lancers The Method: Polish as a first step in my face care routine. I used the product by wetting my face, putting a dime size amount onto fingers and massaging it into the skin just like you would do a sugar scrub on the body. At first I applied too much pressure and it was very unpleasant, but I realized if you barely apply pressure and let the product do the work it is significantly better. I have used exfoliants in the past with no luck, but this one I saw results almost immediately with all of my dead skin and uneven texture getting a little better each time I used the product. It left my face feeling smooth. I do have rosacea which was in a flare when I started and thanks to adding this to my routine it seems so much better now. Although it did not eliminate rosacea it did leave my skin smoother and healthier making it easier for my other products to absorb so much better into the healthy skin. * I received this product from lancer in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: There are better exfoliators out there
avis.texte: The price for this is laughable. There are better options out there for a facial exfoliator.
This is my go to for the past 7 years. I use it daily. It makes my skin smooth and fresh looking. Can't imagine life without it :)

I've been using the method polish now for two weeks and actually look forward to it! Not only do I feel like my skin looks much brighter and glowy, the smell is luxurious! I'll definitely be sharing this product with all the women in my life. â­ï¸

Not sure if I wanted tinted or a no-tint sunscreen. We'll see.
I have used Lancer products for 4 years and it has transformed my skin. Thank you Ulta for carrying it now. So much more convenient!
I haven't been using this long, but I love the way it makes my skin feel after using. I use this with the other 2 products in the method.
I have been using the Polish since it came out, many many years ago. I am 64 years old and women compliment me all the time on my skin and its GLOW!!! Thank you Dr. Lancer !

I've tried many very expensive medical grade skin polishes. I really like Lancers so far. The product is affordable and leaves skin soft, and prepared for the after treatment I use. I would recommend this product.
